novel_features.name: Orphan detector
novel_features.description: Find entries with no incoming references, content types with zero entries, and assets nobody links to — across the entire space, in seconds.

novel_features.name: Reference graph walker
novel_features.description: Walk the reference graph forward (what does this entry reference) and reverse (what references this entry) to any depth, offline.

novel_features.name: Full environment diff
novel_features.description: Diff two environments across entries, content types, releases, scheduled actions, tags, tasks, and roles — the surfaces contentful-merge skips.

novel_features.name: Migration generator
novel_features.description: Diff two environments and emit a runnable contentful-migration JS script. Inverts the painful 'make changes manually then write a script that mimics them' workflow.

novel_features.name: Field usage analyzer
novel_features.description: Per-locale fill rate for a field; distribution of value shapes; flags fields defined on a content type that no entry uses.

novel_features.name: SQL-driven bulk operations
novel_features.description: Use a SQL WHERE against the local mirror to pick which entries to publish, unpublish, or validate — with --dry-run for safety and rate-aware execution that respects X-Contentful-RateLimit-* headers.

novel_features.name: Local content validation
novel_features.description: Run the content-type validations (regex, range, in, linkContentType) against the local entries mirror and report violations — no API calls.

novel_features.name: Broken-reference finder
novel_features.description: Flags entries whose link fields point at deleted, archived, or unpublished targets — per locale, per environment.

novel_features.name: Resumable rate-aware migrator
novel_features.description: Run a contentful-migration script with a local checkpoint table; reads X-Contentful-RateLimit-Reset to time backoff; resumes on crash without re-running completed entries.

novel_features.name: GraphQL impact analyzer
novel_features.description: Given a content-type field about to be removed, scan local .graphql/.ts/.tsx files in cwd for queries referencing it and print file:line.

novel_features.name: Image URL builder with srcset
novel_features.description: Build images.ctfassets.net URLs with all transforms (w/h/fit/format/quality); --bulk for many assets; --srcset emits ready-to-paste HTML.
